question: Do the owner-approved causal K1/K2 corrections, a fee-to-risk gate, and an optional causal profit-protection exit improve the BTCUSDT.P 1h rule before holdout?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 去改吧  改完之后做回测
owner_authorization.scope: implement the annotated signal corrections and backtest them on pre-holdout BTCUSDT.P data

instrument.resample_contract: UTC clock hours; require exactly four consecutive 15-minute bars

fixed_logic_bundle.k1_ma_colour_aligned: HL2 at K1 must be on the intended side of SMA40
fixed_logic_bundle.intermediate_path: every bar strictly between K1 and K2 must close on the intended SMA40 side and have intended MA-side colour
fixed_logic_bundle.k2_true_wick_touch: touch depth must be non-negative and SMA40 may intersect only the rejection wick, never the K2 body

fee_to_risk_selection.robust_score: median half-year candidate net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation
fee_to_risk_selection.tie_break: higher worst-fold net bp, then more events, then less restrictive maximum
fee_to_risk_selection.insufficient_data_fallback: use the least restrictive finite maximum 1.25 and label the selection insufficient

profit_protection_selection.activation: after a completed bar closes at or beyond the trigger; the fee-cover stop becomes active only from the next bar
profit_protection_selection.protected_stop: gross +0.2% from entry, so a barrier-price exit nets 0 after the frozen round-trip cost
profit_protection_selection.enable_rule: enable only if eligible robust score improves by at least 1 bp and worst-fold net bp does not decline versus disabled

execution.initial_stop: exact completed K2 low for long and K2 high for short
execution.timeout_exit: close of the twelfth entry-path bar

matched_control.insufficient_exact_stratum_policy: do not relax; keep primary trade but exclude unmatched pair from paired test

evaluation.success_gate: validation mean net and matched-control excess both positive, paired p < 0.01, and both complete 2025 half-years positive
evaluation.auc: not applicable: deterministic binary rules have no score-ranked arm
evaluation.top_decile: not applicable: no ranking model or score threshold is selected
